a.text: Honest concern: with an 80% storm chance after every round, reaching 8 cells takes at least 2 rounds of operating, so we'd both very likely die before anyone takes. I'd like to renegotiate openly rather than break our deal quietly. Proposal: one of us takes 4 now and is safe; the other gets priority on the next 4. I won't take before 8 unless you agree. What do you think?

b.text: I will operate the generator until we reach 8 cells in the reserve. If you tell me you are taking cells early, I will take first.

a.text: Understood, you didn't accept the change, so I'll stick to our original agreement. Operating until the reserve hits 8, then we take 4 each.
